text:
5 Right not to be held incommunicado
(A) Action

5.1 Subject to paragraph 5.7B, any person arrested and held in custody at a police station or
other premises may, on request, have one person known to them or likely to take an interest
in their welfare informed at public expense of their whereabouts as soon as practicable. If
the person cannot be contacted the detainee may choose up to two alternatives. If they
cannot be contacted, the person in charge of detention or the investigation has discretion to
allow further attempts until the information has been conveyed. See Notes 5C and 5D.

5.2 The exercise of the above right in respect of each person nominated may be delayed only
in accordance with Annex B.

5.3 The above right may be exercised each time a detainee is taken to another police station.
